candidates.snippet: 1944: Joins ANC Youth League - Mandela co-founds the African National Congress (ANC) Youth League, becoming a prominent figure in the anti-apartheid movement. 1964: Sentenced to life imprisonment - Mandela is sentenced to life imprisonment during the Rivonia Trial for sabotage and other charges against the apartheid government. 1990: Released from prison - After 27 years of imprisonment, Nelson Mandela is released, marking a pivotal moment in the fight against apartheid. 1994: Elected President of South Africa - Mandela is elected as the first post-apartheid President of South Africa, ushering in a new era of democracy.
